faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Does XZACTO POS keep working if the internet goes down?
faq.a1: Yes. Both the Android app and Web POS queue sales, utang payments, expenses, and warehouse counts offline and sync automatically once signal returns.
faq.q2: Can one warehouse supply multiple stores?
faq.a2: Yes. Full Mode pairs low-stock stores against your warehouses and lets managers dispatch warehouse-to-store transfers with printable pick lists and manifests.
faq.q3: Can we mix Android phones and PC web browsers?
faq.a3: Yes. Cashiers can sell on Android phones or desktop browsers, warehouse clerks can receive and count on mobile, and owners can monitor everything from the web.
faq.q4: How are cashiers and admins separated?
faq.a4: Role-based permissions lock cashiers to counter POS, shifts, and store stock, while warehouse clerks only see receiving, bins, counts, and transfers.
